<style id="mfn-custom-inline-css">
/* =========================================================
   GLOBAL
   ========================================================= */

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

a {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.fj-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.grid-4 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   CTA
   ========================================================= */

.cta-container {
  padding: 5px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.cta-unit,
button {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  background-color: rgb(36, 108, 0);
  color: white;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 15px;
  border: none;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.cta-unit:hover,
button:hover {
  transform: scale(0.95) !important;
}

.cta-unit i {
  color: white;
}


/* =========================================================
   UTILITY
   ========================================================= */

.hidden-dekstop {
  display: none;
}

.the_content_wrapper {
  margin: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

.m-0 {
  margin: 0;
}

.m-auto {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.ml-20 {
  margin-left: 20px;
}

.mb-20 {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.py-20 {
  padding-top: 20px;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
}

.px-20 {
  padding-left: 20px;
  padding-right: 20px;
}

.px-30 {
  padding-left: 30px;
  padding-right: 30px;
}

.plr-20 {
  padding: 0 20px;
}

.p-10 {
  padding: 10px;
}

.p-20 {
  padding: 20px;
}

.p-30 {
  padding: 30px;
}

.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.rounded-lg {
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
}

.bg-white {
  background-color: #ffffff;
}

.texture-2 {
  background-image: var(--wpr-bg-0d285dcd-cf45-4a7f-949b-e64605762608);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: left 0 bottom 0;
}

.shadow-sm {
  box-shadow:
    rgba(50, 50, 93, 0.25) 0 2px 5px -1px,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0 1px 3px -1px;
}

.shadow-xl {
  box-shadow: 0 8px 12px 0 rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.06);
}

#border-0 {
  border-width: 0 !important;
}

.max-w-1200 {
  max-width: 1200px;
}

.max-w-1100 {
  max-width: 1100px;
}

.w-80 {
  width: 80%;
}


/* =========================================================
   HEADER SLIDER
   ========================================================= */

.hero {
  margin: 40px auto;
  max-width: 1200px;
}

.hero-container {
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 12px rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.06);
  padding: 40px;
}

.hero-grid {
  display: flex;
  gap: 30px;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-menu {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.hero-menu-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f2;
  border-left: 2.5px solid transparent;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition:
    border-color 0.2s ease,
    padding-left 0.2s ease;
}

.hero-menu-item:hover {
  border-left-color: #e8891c;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding-left: 18px;
}

.hero-menu-icon {
  height: 34px !important;
  width: 34px;
}

.hero-menu-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #152c4e;
  position: relative;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.hero-menu-title::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: -2px;
  height: 1.5px;
  width: 0;
  background: #e8891c;
  transition: width 0.2s ease;
}

.hero-menu-item:hover .hero-menu-title {
  color: #e8891c;
}

.hero-menu-item:hover .hero-menu-title::after {
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-slider {
  flex: 3;
}

.hero-image {
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.mobile {
  display: none;
}


/* =========================================================
   INTRODUCTION
   ========================================================= */

.sec-intro-homp {
  padding: 20px 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  justify-content: center;
}

.introduction {
  width: 65%;
  padding: 0 40px;
}

.introduction h1 {
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.introduction p {
  color: #152c4e;
}

.introduction ul {
  color: #152c4e !important;
  list-style: none;
}

.introduction ul li {
  padding-left: 24px;
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.introduction ul li::before {
  content: "✓";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  color: #152c4e;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.intro-img-homp {
  width: 35%;
}

.intro-img-homp img {
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 3px solid #ffffff;
  box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0 4px 12px;
  max-width: 400px;
  height: auto;
}


/* =========================================================
   LAYANAN
   ========================================================= */

.jenis-layanan-homp {
  background-color: #2155b1;
  padding: 30px 0 50px;
}

.jenis-layanan-homp h2 {
  color: #ffffff;
  text-align: center;
  width: 80%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 20px 0;
}

.cont-layanan {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  padding-left: 20px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.layanan-overflow {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 31%;
}

.layanan {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  background-image: var(--wpr-bg-9bfb4ca1-7b9d-4488-872c-310d649d4960);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 20px;
}

.layanan h3 {
  font-weight: bolder;
}


/* =========================================================
   LIST UNIT
   ========================================================= */

.cont-list-unit {
  width: 100%;
  background-color: #f1f5f8;
  padding: 0 0 80px;
}

.box-list-armada {
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.intro-unit-mobil {
  width: 70%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.review-gmap a:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.unit-mobil {
  width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18);
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: 1px solid #2563eb;
  transition:
    box-shadow 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}

.unit-mobil:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.unit-mobil img {
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
}

.tipe-mobil-card {
  background-color: #dd7b00e0;
  display: inline;
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 4px 15px;
  font-size: 13px;
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 8px;
  line-height: 13px;
  left: 20px;
  top: 20px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.jumlah-kursi {
  background-color: #0747a9e0;
  display: inline;
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 4px 15px;
  font-size: 13px;
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 8px;
  line-height: 13px;
  right: 20px;
  top: 20px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.car-name {
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding: 0 10px;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.unit-mobil-sumb {
  width: calc(33% - 30px);
  padding: 10px;
  position: relative;
  margin-right: 10px;
}

.spesifikasi-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr 1fr;
  gap: 5px;
  width: 50%;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.spesifikasi {
  padding: 2px;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: lightblue;
}

.data-harga-mobil {
  padding: 0 15px 5px;
}

.tarif {
  margin: 0 0 2px;
  line-height: normal;
  font-weight: 300;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.harga-mobil {
  line-height: normal;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.harga-mobil span {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 300;
}


/* =========================================================
   WHY CHOOSE US
   ========================================================= */

.cont-why-choose-us {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 80px 0;
}

.cont-why-choose-us h2 {
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}

.why-choose {
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
  color: #000000;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
  background-image: var(--wpr-bg-18b46732-d3eb-4d98-bcd8-2607bd84153b);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: top right;
  background-size: auto;
  background-attachment: scroll;
}

.why-choose h3 {
  color: #000000;
}

.why-choose p {
  font-size: 13px;
}

.box-icon-why-choose {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  border-radius: 60px;
  display: inline-flex;
}

.img-icon-why-choose {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center center;
  border: 4px solid #1b2c5b !important;
  border-radius: 100%;
  padding: 4px;
}

.why-choose-overflow {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 20%;
}

.box-why-choose {
  max-width: 1100px;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  gap: 15px;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  animation-duration: 0.3s;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}


/* =========================================================
   REVIEW GOOGLE MAP
   ========================================================= */

.review-gmap {
  padding: 60px 20px;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.review-gmap h2 {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   INSTAGRAM
   ========================================================= */

.follow-us-insta-lkl {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 60px 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   TIPS SEWA
   ========================================================= */

.cont-tips-sewa {
  padding: 60px 20px;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}


/* =========================================================
   BOOKING
   ========================================================= */

.card-c-da {
  background:
    var(--wpr-bg-76bc7f3c-71c5-44b3-8227-b8610700bb68),
    var(--wpr-bg-f36c79a7-d0fa-47ba-94ab-4c867990a708),
    linear-gradient(
      142.5deg,
      #0084cc 16.08%,
      #2fb6c0 68.79%,
      #2fa6c0 121.19%
    );
  background-position:
    100% 0,
    0 100%,
    50%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: contain, contain, contain;
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   ACTION BUTTON
   ========================================================= */

.cont-action-button {
  padding: 60px 20px;
  background-color: #ff8e00e0;
}


/* =========================================================

   ========================================================= */

  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #243a8f, #1c2f73) !important;
  background-color: #1c30a0;
}

.footer-container {
  padding: 20px;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif;
}

.footer-container p {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.footer-grid {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: auto;
  display: grid;
  gap: 60px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
}

.img-zoom {
  display: inline-block;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.img-zoom img {
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
  display: block;
}

.img-zoom:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.08);
}

.footer-title {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.footer-logo {
  width: 120px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

p.footer-website {
  margin: 0;
}

.footer-website a {
  color: #fff;
}

.footer-label {
  font-size: 18px !important;
}

.footer-contact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.social-icons {
  display: flex;
  gap: 15px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.social-icons a {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.social-icons img {
  width: 40px;
}

.social-icons a:hover {
  background: #ffcc00;
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.payment-logos,
.partner-logos {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.payment-item {
  width: 64px;
  height: 48px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.payment-item img {
  max-width: 42px;
  height: auto;
  filter: grayscale(100%);
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, filter 0.3s ease;
}

.payment-item:hover img {
  filter: grayscale(0);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.partner-item {
  width: 64px;
  height: 48px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.partner-item img {
  max-width: 42px;
  height: auto;
  filter: grayscale(100%);
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, filter 0.3s ease;
}

.partner-item:hover img {
  filter: grayscale(0);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.map-responsive {
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 60%;
  height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.map-responsive iframe {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
}


/* =========================================================
   BUTTON
   ========================================================= */

.btn-modif-1 {
  background: linear-gradient(268deg, #1f77d3 1.1%, #06519f 99.1%);
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border-radius: 60px;
  padding: 10px 12px 10px 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: normal;
  transition: background 0.5s;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  width: fit-content;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.btn-modif-1:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(268deg, #06519f 1.1%, #1f77d3 99.1%);
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
}


/* =========================================================
   MAP CONTENT
   ========================================================= */

.konten {
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    max-height 0.5s ease,
    opacity 0.4s ease,
    transform 0.4s ease;
  opacity: 0;
  max-height: 0;
  transform: translateY(-20px);
}

.konten.open {
  max-height: 600px;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}


/* =========================================================
   POSTS
   ========================================================= */

.posts_group {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 36px;
}

.post-item {
  width: 100% !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid black;
}

.post-item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
   ========================================================= */

@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {

  .posts_group {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .grid-4 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .spesifikasi-container {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .unit-mobil-sumb {
    width: calc(50% - 30px);
  }

  .hidden-dekstop {
    display: inherit !important;
  }

  .hidden-mobile {
    display: none;
  }

  .the_content_wrapper {
    margin: 0 1%;

  }

  .sm-p-0 {
    padding: 0 !important;
  }

  .sm-p-20 {
    padding: 20px !important;
  }

  .sm-mb-0 {
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  }

  .sm-text-left {
    text-align: left;
  }

    background-color: unset !important;
    box-shadow: unset !important;
  }

  .section_wrapper.mfn-wrapper-for-wraps.mcb-section-inner.mcb-section-inner-58c0a274 {
    padding: 0 !important;
  }

  .sm-flex-col-reverse {
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
  }


  /* HEADER SLIDER */

  .hero {
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .hero-container {
    padding: 0;
  }

  .hero-grid {
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .hero-menu {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: unset;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .hero-menu-item {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    text-align: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-menu-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 18px;
  }

  .hero-image {
    border-radius: 0;
  }

  .desktop {
    display: none;
  }

  .mobile {
    display: block;
  }


  /* INTRODUCTION */

  .sec-intro-homp {

  }

    max-width: 400px !important;

  }

  .cont-layanan {
    justify-content: unset;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .layanan-overflow {
    width: 320px;
  }


  /* LIST UNIT */

  .cont-list-unit {
    padding: 0 0 10px;
  }

  .box-list-armada {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .intro-unit-mobil {
    width: 100%;
    margin: unset;
    padding: 0 20px 20px;
  }

  .list-unit-mobil {
    padding: 0 10px;
  }

  .tipe-mobil-card {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 2.6vw;
    line-height: normal;
    border-radius: 6px;
    left: 12px;
    top: 17px;
  }

    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 2.6vw;
    line-height: normal;
    border-radius: 6px;
    right: 12px;
    top: 17px;
  }

  .car-name {
    font-size: 2.9vw;
    margin: 0 0 5px;
    font-weight: bolder;
  }

  .tarif {
    font-size: 3.48vw;
  }

  .harga-mobil {
    font-size: 2.9vw;
  }

  .harga-mobil span {
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .why-choose {
    padding: 30px 20px 0;
    min-height: 340px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .why-choose h3 {

    line-height: 28px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .why-choose p {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 24px;
  }

  .box-why-choose {
    margin: 0 auto;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
  }

  .why-choose-overflow {
    width: 260px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

    padding: 60px 0 42px;
  }

  .cont-why-choose-us h2 {
    padding: 0 20px 12px;
  }

  .img-icon-why-choose {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
  }


  /* FOOTER */

  .footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 40px;
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   MODAL
   ========================================================= */

.modal {
  display: flex;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease;
  z-index: 999;
}

.modal.active {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

.modal-content {
  max-width: 90%;
  max-height: 80%;
  transform: scale(0.8);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.modal.active .modal-content {
  transform: scale(1);
}

.close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 25px;
  color: white;
  font-size: 30px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

<script type="rocketlazyloadscript">
(function() {
  var endpoint = '/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?_embed&per_page=3';
  var tagClasses = ['blog-card__tag--navy', 'blog-card__tag--orange', 'blog-card__tag--emerald'];

  function stripHtml(html) {
    if (!html) return '';
    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
    return doc.body.textContent || '';
  }

  function formatDate(isoStr) {
    if (!isoStr) return 'Update Terbaru';
    try {
      var d = new Date(isoStr);
      var months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Ags', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'];
      return d.getDate() + ' ' + months[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getFullYear();
    } catch(e) {
      return 'Update Terbaru';
    }
  }

  function calcReadingTime(contentHtml) {
    var text = stripHtml(contentHtml);
    var wordCount = text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
    var minutes = Math.max(3, Math.round(wordCount / 200));
    return minutes + ' Menit Baca';
  }

  fetch(endpoint)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('API request failed');
      return res.json();
    })
    .then(function(posts) {
      if (!Array.isArray(posts) || posts.length === 0) return;
      var grid = document.getElementById('blogGrid');
      if (!grid) return;

      var cardsHtml = posts.map(function(post, index) {
        var title = post.title && post.title.rendered ? post.title.rendered : 'Artikel Rental Mobil';
        var link = post.link || '#';
        var dateStr = formatDate(post.date);
        var readTime = calcReadingTime(post.content && post.content.rendered ? post.content.rendered : '');
        var rawExcerpt = stripHtml(post.excerpt && post.excerpt.rendered ? post.excerpt.rendered : '');
        var excerpt = rawExcerpt.length > 150 ? rawExcerpt.substring(0, 150) + '...' : rawExcerpt;

        // Category Tag
        var category = 'Tips Sewa';
        if (post._embedded && post._embedded['wp:term'] && post._embedded['wp:term'][0]) {
          var terms = post._embedded['wp:term'][0];
          var validTerm = terms.find(function(t) {
            return t.name && t.name.toLowerCase() !== 'uncategorized';
          });
          if (validTerm) category = validTerm.name;
        }

        // Featured Image
        var imgHtml = '';
        var overlayHtml = '';
        if (post._embedded && post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'] && post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0]) {
          var media = post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0];
          var imgSrc = (media.media_details && media.media_details.sizes && media.media_details.sizes.medium_large)
            ? media.media_details.sizes.medium_large.source_url
            : media.source_url;
          if (imgSrc) {
            var imgAlt = (media.alt_text || title).replace(/"/g, '"');
            imgHtml = '<img src="' + imgSrc + '" alt="' + imgAlt + '" class="blog-card__photo" loading="lazy" />';
            overlayHtml = '<div class="blog-card__cover-overlay"></div>';
          }
        }

        var tagClass = tagClasses[index % tagClasses.length];

        return '<article class="blog-card">' +
          '<div class="blog-card__cover">' +
            imgHtml +
            overlayHtml +
            '<span class="blog-card__tag ' + tagClass + '">' + category + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="blog-card__body">' +
            '<div class="blog-card__meta">' + dateStr + ' • ' + readTime + '</div>' +
            '<h3 class="blog-card__title">' + title + '</h3>' +
            '<p class="blog-card__excerpt">' + excerpt + '</p>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="blog-card__footer">' +
            '<a href="' + link + '" class="blog-card__link">' +
              '<span>Baca Selengkapnya</span>' +
              '<span aria-hidden="true">→</span>' +
            '</a>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</article>';
      }).join('');

      grid.innerHTML = cardsHtml;
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
      // Graceful fallback: 3 artikel statis di HTML tetap aktif melayani pengunjung
      console.warn('WP REST API hydration notice:', err);
    });
})();

          Bandara ZAM Praya. Anda bisa meminta serah terima kunci unit sewa
          lepas kunci di bandara, atau memesan mobil dengan sopir untuk langsung

console.log("JS Terhubung!");
(function () {
  /* ============================================
     UTILITAS — null-safe querySelector
     ============================================ */
  function $(id) {
    return document.getElementById(id);
  }

  /* ============================================
     1. SHOW/HIDE KONTEN (code existing Anda)
        Diperbaiki: null-check sebelum addEventListener
     ============================================ */
  function initShowBtn() {
    var btn = $("show-btn");
    var konten = $("konten");
    if (!btn || !konten) return; // ← tidak error jika elemen tidak ada
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      konten.classList.toggle("open");
    });
  }

  /* ============================================
     2. MODAL GAMBAR (code existing Anda)
        Diperbaiki:
        - null-check modal, modalImg, closeBtn
        - hanya gambar di luar <a> yang trigger modal
        - hanya gambar di luar .lkl-ar-thumb yang trigger
          (thumb punya fungsi sendiri)
     ============================================ */
  function initImageModal() {
    var modal = $("imageModal");
    var modalImg = $("modalImg");
    var closeBtn = document.querySelector(".close");

    if (!modal || !modalImg || !closeBtn) return; // ← tidak error jika elemen tidak ada

    document.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(function (img) {
      if (img.closest("a")) return; // skip gambar dalam link
      if (img.closest(".lkl-ar-thumb")) return; // skip thumbnail armada
      img.style.cursor = "zoom-in";
      img.addEventListener("click", function () {
        modal.classList.add("active");
        modalImg.src = img.src;
      });
    });

    closeBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      modal.classList.remove("active");
    });

    modal.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      if (e.target === modal) modal.classList.remove("active");
    });

    // Tutup modal dengan tombol ESC
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") modal.classList.remove("active");
    });
  }

  /* ============================================
     3. GALLERY FOTO ARMADA (code baru)
        Ganti foto utama saat thumbnail diklik
     ============================================ */
  function initArmadaGallery() {
    var mainImg = $("lkl-ar-main-img");
    var placeholder = $("lkl-ar-photo-placeholder");
    if (!mainImg) return;

    document.querySelectorAll(".lkl-ar-thumb").forEach(function (thumb) {
      thumb.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var src = thumb.dataset.src;
        if (!src) return;
        mainImg.src = src;
        mainImg.style.display = "block";
        if (placeholder) placeholder.style.display = "none";
        document.querySelectorAll(".lkl-ar-thumb").forEach(function (t) {
          t.classList.remove("lkl-ar-thumb--active");
        });
        thumb.classList.add("lkl-ar-thumb--active");
      });
    });
  }

  /* ============================================
     4. FAQ ACCORDION ARMADA (code baru)
        Toggle buka/tutup jawaban FAQ
     ============================================ */
  function initArmadaFaq() {
    var faqs = document.querySelectorAll(".lkl-ar-faq-q");
    console.log("FAQ ditemukan:", faqs.length); // ← cek berapa FAQ terdeteksi

    faqs.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        console.log("FAQ diklik!"); // ← cek apakah event terpanggil
        var answer = btn.nextElementSibling;
        if (!answer) return;
        var isOpen = answer.classList.contains("lkl-ar-faq-a--open");

        document.querySelectorAll(".lkl-ar-faq-a").forEach(function (a) {
          a.classList.remove("lkl-ar-faq-a--open");
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".lkl-ar-faq-q").forEach(function (q) {
          q.classList.remove("lkl-ar-faq-q--open");
        });

        if (!isOpen) {
          answer.classList.add("lkl-ar-faq-a--open");
          btn.classList.add("lkl-ar-faq-q--open");
        }
      });
    });
  }
  function initSnkToggle() {
    var btns = document.querySelectorAll(".snk-btn");
    if (!btns.length) return;

    // Elemen tambahan khusus luar Lombok (punya id, akan di-toggle)
    var extraItems = document.querySelectorAll(".lkl-ar-term-item[data-extra]");

    btns.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        btns.forEach(function (b) {
          b.classList.remove("active");
        });
        btn.classList.add("active");

        var isLuar = btn.dataset.target === "luar";

        // Tampilkan/sembunyikan syarat tambahan
        extraItems.forEach(function (el) {
          if (isLuar) {
            el.classList.remove("hide");
          } else {
            el.classList.add("hide");
          }
        });
      });
    });
  }

  /* ============================================
     INIT — jalankan semua setelah DOM siap
     ============================================ */
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    initShowBtn();
    initImageModal();
    initArmadaGallery();
    initArmadaFaq();
    initSnkToggle();
  });
})();
(function () {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const tombolFilter = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-jenis');
    const semuaCard = document.querySelectorAll('.unit-mobil');

    if (!tombolFilter.length || !semuaCard.length) {
      return;
    }

    const DELAY_PER_CARD = 0.07; // jarak delay antar card, dalam detik

    function playFadeUp(cardsVisible) {
      cardsVisible.forEach(function (card, i) {
        card.classList.remove('fade-up');
        card.style.removeProperty('--fade-delay');

        void card.offsetWidth; // paksa reflow, supaya animasi bisa diulang

        card.style.setProperty('--fade-delay', (i * DELAY_PER_CARD) + 's');
        card.classList.add('fade-up');
      });
    }

    function terapkanFilter(target) {
      const cardVisible = [];

      semuaCard.forEach(function (card) {
        const cocok = target === 'semua' || card.classList.contains('jenis-' + target);
        card.style.display = cocok ? '' : 'none';
        if (cocok) cardVisible.push(card);
      });

      playFadeUp(cardVisible);
    }

    // animasi saat pertama kali load (semua card tampil)
    terapkanFilter('semua');

    tombolFilter.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        tombolFilter.forEach(function (b) {
          b.classList.remove('active');
        });
        btn.classList.add('active');

        terapkanFilter(btn.dataset.target);
      });
    });
  });
})();
